asset.name: Drawer
asset.description: The edge-attached panel with modal or non-modal presentation, drag gestures, velocity-aware dismissal, responsive sizing, focus management, and safe-area handling.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Background and elevation come from the shared surface primitive rather than per-overlay shadow values.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and reduced-motion collapse are owned once.
Modal contexts contain focus, including nested scopes.
Focus returns to the trigger, or a deterministic fallback, on close.
Scroll locking is reference-counted so nested modals do not fight.
Escape closes only the topmost eligible surface.
Open state uses the shared controlled and uncontrolled contract.
Drag-to-dismiss shares axis locking and velocity thresholds.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.
